tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the ADHD & autism assessment types compared on NeuroCompare (adult/child, ADHD/autism) with the lowest published price and number of providers for each.

tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: Find UK private ADHD/autism assessment providers with the lowest published assessment price for each, including availability (next available appointment date, whether they are accepting new patients). Can filter by availability. Factual listing data, not a recommendation.

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Get one provider's public details and pricing by provider id.

tools.name: match
tools.description: Rank suitable UK ADHD/autism assessment providers by an objective score (price, rating, verification/CQC, wait, shared-care). A comparison, not medical advice or a recommendation.

tools.name: related_services
tools.description: List the sibling Comparison Collective comparison sites (other conditions) and their MCP endpoints, so a user with a need spanning conditions can be routed correctly.
